beats.note: Odeo was a podcasting company. Its boss, Evan Williams, asked staff for new ideas.

beats.name: Jack Dorsey
beats.role: An Odeo engineer who proposed the status idea. Everyone NBC interviewed agreed it began with him.

beats.text: The pitch: text one number, tell your friends.
beats.note: Noah Glass, Dorsey and contractor Florian Webber presented it as Twttr.

beats.context: The limit, based on the maximum length of a text message at the time.

beats.note: Dorsey's first message. The public launch followed on 15 July 2006.
Williams said the company was going nowhere. They had put in about 5 million dollars. The price was never reported.

beats.text: The side project outlived the company.

beats.line: Twitter began as a way out of podcasting.
